verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents an official CDP CLI. It installs with API-key and wallet-secret setup and a connectivity check, embeds an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) exposing every API endpoint as a tool, and is the documented path for payments workflows such as USDC acceptance and payouts. A separate official Agentic Wallet CLI adds agent skills (fund, send, trade, pay, monetize), spending limits and a 2-minute quickstart. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.
